tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Run the complete Vitest test suite to verify all existing tests pass and the codebase is in a healthy state.
2. READ FIRST: Read package.json to confirm the test script command. Read src/test/setup.ts to understand test configuration.
3. FILES: No files to modify — this is a validation-only task.
4. APPROACH: Run `npx vitest run` from the project root to execute all test files. Check exit code and review any failures.
5. PATTERNS: Test files follow the pattern `*.test.ts` and `*.test.tsx` in `src/components/` and `src/auth/`.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0 — all tests pass
No test files are skipped or pending
